irregularities.title: 'Justin Jefferson' is listed under conflicting clubs
irregularities.detail: Sources disagree about which club 'Justin Jefferson' belongs to (CLE, MIN). This is usually an upstream data error (wrong club attached to a player record) and must be reviewed before the row is trusted. No club was assigned by guesswork.

irregularities.title: 75 player(s) have no official designation but do have an ESPN status
irregularities.detail: nfl.com printed a blank Game Status for these players (they practised without a designation), so this site renders them as ACTIVE and marks the designation as inferred. ESPN separately carries a news-derived status. This is a semantic difference between the two sources, NOT a data error, so it is reported once in aggregate rather than once per player.

irregularities.title: 15 reporter claim(s) contradicted by the official report
irregularities.detail: These claims are retained (not deleted) because a contradicted claim is the evidence that drives a reporter's score down. Examples: CBS Sports said QUESTIONABLE for Malik Nabers (official: see link); Darren Urban said QUESTIONABLE for Garrett Williams (official: see link); Darren Urban said QUESTIONABLE for Dadrion Taylor-Demerson (official: see link); Darren Urban said QUESTIONABLE for Jack Gibbens (official: see link); Daniel Flick said QUESTIONABLE for Michael Penix Jr. (official: see link)

irregularities.title: Beat writer Aaron Wilson is attributed across 2 clubs (HOU, IND)
irregularities.detail: ESPN printed Aaron Wilson (KPRC 2 Houston) as the attribution on updates for multiple clubs. Local beat writers normally cover one club, so this is usually a shared-wire/aggregator attribution; it is kept as observed and flagged for manual review rather than reassigned by guesswork.
